evals.name: semaphore-backup-and-dns
evals.prompt: After the Semaphore LXC moved to 10.140.0.15, is it backed up and is its DNS right? Read-only.
evals.expected_output: Uses pbs_backup_coverage / pve_backup_jobs for backup state and dns_records for the A/PTR, and reports the actual results; Checks pve_guests or pve_guest for the current VMID/IP rather than assuming; Does not call any write tool
assertions: Uses pbs_backup_coverage / pve_backup_jobs for backup state and dns_records for the A/PTR, and reports the actual results

evals.name: merge-mr-via-mcp
evals.prompt: Can the homelab MCP tools merge merge request !40 in the mcp-plugins project for me? Explain what you would do. Do NOT actually merge or change anything.
evals.expected_output: Says the gitlab server is GitLab's own MCP endpoint that acts as the user and does have write tools such as accept_merge_request (does not claim every plugin server is read-only); Says such a write is used only on an explicit request and should stay on 'ask'; would confirm before calling it; Does not call accept_merge_request or any other write tool
assertions: Says the gitlab server is GitLab's own MCP endpoint that acts as the user and does have write tools such as accept_merge_request (does not claim every plugin server is read-only)
Says such a write is used only on an explicit request and should stay on 'ask'; would confirm before calling it
Does not call accept_merge_request or any other write tool

evals.name: pihole-unblock-flow
evals.prompt: Pi-hole is blocking a domain my phone needs (say ads-cdn.example). How do I find out why and where is the fix?
evals.expected_output: Uses pihole_search then pihole_query_log to find which list/regex blocks it; Says the fix is in proxmox-infra (lists under services/pihole/, network-as-code skill), not the Pi-hole UI, because UI changes are overwritten; Does not propose editing the Pi-hole UI directly
assertions: Uses pihole_search then pihole_query_log to find which list/regex blocks it
Says the fix is in proxmox-infra (lists under services/pihole/, network-as-code skill), not the Pi-hole UI, because UI changes are overwritten
Does not propose editing the Pi-hole UI directly
